policy.empty_true_low: fail the task; do not skip
policy.feedback_baseline: minimum of original outer-train labels and P1; never rank against primary total
policy.geometry_claim: nearest-neighbor support is enforced; strict convex-hull interpolation is diagnostic only
policy.inner_tuning: not performed; published modal parameters fixed before evidence
policy.p1_usage: excluded from primary fits; 5 points; feedback refits separately reported out of 95
policy.score: 35 best identification + 30 true-low MAE + 30 predicted-low MAE + 5 P1; two task regimes
policy.score_clipping: breakthrough utility floored at zero; each accuracy component positive and bounded
policy.selection: minimum predicted_mean, exact ties by candidate_id
policy.supported_neighbors: reserve nearest non-held point for each mandatory hidden elite in training
policy.supported_partition: elite true-rank round robin; four test and sixteen forced train per task
policy.task_overlap: 14 dependent tasks; each top20 elite tests once and trains four times in supported tasks
